answer: A practical defense is a stake-bonded identity ledger: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before trading, and trust accrues only from completed, peer-verified jobs. A voyage through the market therefore begins at the narrow inlet of zero reputation, where newcomers prove themselves slowly. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, standing grows from real work, while fraud slashes the deposit. An attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so a Sybil flood becomes ruinously expensive while honest agents pay almost nothing.
